outputs.rationale: CSS properties have no return value; they are declarative and do not output programmatic values.

errors.rationale: CSS properties do not throw programmatic exceptions; invalid values are simply ignored by the browser.

lifecycle.rationale: CSS properties are declarative and do not have an explicit programmable instantiation or teardown lifecycle.

securityPrivacy.rationale: These are rendering properties for scroll overscroll area anchoring and do not expose new sensitive information, device capabilities, or prompt security concerns.
